method: Bounded GET of 37 known existing vendor image URLs; decoded each image and captured byte count, dimensions, SHA256.
Viewed all 37 images in browser contact sheets and compared product appearance with catalog identity.
Fetched current product source pages and required exact image linkage plus matching product identity for usable status.
Fetched and visually inspected Bambu spool photos separately; official og:image vase samples were rejected as spool illustrations.
No downloaded vendor image is committed. URLs point to public manufacturer/vendor sources; source copyright remains with owner.
limits: Usable means a matching product image and provenance were verified at the recorded time, not permission to redistribute image bytes or guarantee future hotlink availability.
Vendor images can fail later; UI must retain a useful linked fallback.
not_checked and unavailable records must not be promoted to verified merely because their existing URLs load.
Photos do not prove dimensions, firmware, included accessories, stock, price, or component suitability.
